name: cache-bar
description: One colored line above the prompt: the prompt cache countdown, context fill, and the plan's 5-hour and weekly usage.

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache lifetime
cacheTtl.description: auto (default): CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL, then promptCacheTtl in settings, then 1h on a subscription within its limits and 5m otherwise. Set 5m or 1h to override.
